additional_info.subject: RE: ID0452873-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2/SD 314005673001] Firmware Update Request CRM:03055000034
additional_info.body:
Hi Francisco,
We have discussed this with the customer as we have noticed the same behavior with another charger with the same customer that went offline due to SIM card data issues. We believe that due to the SIM card data issue, the charger is unable to complete the FW update due to the data volume limitation and during this process. Is there any way to confirm that this is the root cause of this issue?
Thanks,
Mohamed

additional_info.subject: ID0452873-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2/SD 314005673001] Firmware Update Request CRM:03055000034
additional_info.body:
Hi Mohamed,
Unfortunately from our side it's not possible. Only requesting this information from the customer directly or the Mobile provider.
We can only assume since the charger was online for a few days in the beginning of the month and possibly after the FW was rollout, we lost connection.
From our side, if this is the case, then putting a new SIM card should give us the answer and if this is the case, then only using USB we can update it.
Let me know your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0452873-DC/Si-D/SA-[Y2/SD 314005673001] Firmware Update Request CRM:03055000034
additional_info.body:
Hi Mohamed, how are you doing? :)
Please let me know how you want to proceed, I am afraid that downloading the FW might cause it go offline again. Right now, charger is online again, so it seems that the data plan can be the cause.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
